# Frozen reference: the assembled prompt and producer command line for every
# topic x every day of the week.
#
# Originally captured from the pre-Epic-4 runner at commit 7705b54 with a clean
# tree. Digest output is non-deterministic, so this — the assembled prompt — is
# the only regression surface that can be compared byte-for-byte.
#
# NEVER regenerate this file to make the suite pass. A reference regenerated
# from the code it is meant to check compares that code with itself and passes
# no matter what broke. A deliberate prompt edit is the one legitimate reason to
# re-freeze, and it must happen in the same commit as the edit, and be said out
# loud in the commit message.
#
# Re-frozen 2026-08-08 (public-feed S1.3). All 28 prompt hashes changed in one
# go because the same edit touched all four topic prompts: the block naming the
# employer was removed from every one of them, this repo being public. No
# producer line, output path or schedule word moved — only the prompt hashes —
# which is what a pure prompt edit is supposed to look like here.
#
# Dates 2026-08-03..09 are a Mon..Sun run, so every schedule word is exercised.
#
# Format:  job=… date=… dow=… schedule=… | output | producer | prompt_sha256
